market_summary: Both GBPUSD and BTCUSD lack clean high-probability breakout confluence during the London session. GBPUSD is pressing into resistance and VAH with bearish CVD divergence, while BTCUSD is languishing near major session support on depressed volume (RVOL < 0.3) without clean expansion momentum. Holding on both.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7-point confluence checklist: 1) VP context: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32531 to VAH 1.32729), trading above POC 1.32577 and testing VAH. 2) CVD: CVD is -3091.86 labeled BEARISH with slope -827.86, diverging negatively against the recent upward push. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION (active, no automation blocks). 4) Trend/baseline: Signal candle closed at 1.32664, above VWAP (1.32649) and live price at 1.32709 reclaims EMA50 (1.32687) with upward trajectory. 5) ATR band: Price is mid-to-upper channel near ATR upper (1.32761). 6) Volume confirmation: Recent surge had yellow RVOL spike 5 bars ago, but signal bar rvol is 1.123 (moderate). 7) S/R reaction: Live price accepted above S/R 1.32661 but immediately faces VAH 1.32729 and Session High 1.32809 while CVD diverges sharply. Due to heavy CVD divergence and proximity to resistance inside the Value Area, setup is conflicting. Prefer HOLD.
